title: Quantification of cell energetics in human subcutaneous adipose progenitor cells after target gene knockdown
protocol: Remove spent media from confluent cells in the T25 flask.
Rinse cells once with pre-warmed PBS by rocking the flask back and forth.
Discard PBS wash solution and add 800 μl-1 ml of Trypsin-EDTA solution to the cells.
Rock the flasks to distribute the trypsin solution evenly over the cells, then incubate at 37°C for 3–5 min.
Add 4 ml of room temperature PGM-2 to each flask after detachment.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 10 min at 20°C–26°C.
Resuspend the cells in 5 ml PGM-2 and remove an aliquot (20 μl) for cell counting.
Plate approximately 15,000 human subcutaneous preadipocyte cells per well into the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate.
Plate approximately 15,000 human subcutaneous preadipocyte cells (125 μL) per well into 8 wells in a standard 48-well tissue culture plate.
Gently shake the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate in all directions by hand before allowing the plate to rest at room temperature for 10 min.
Place both the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate and the standard 48-well tissue culture plate in the tissue culture incubator overnight.
Retrieve the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate and the standard 48-well tissue culture plate from the incubator.
View the cells under the microscope to confirm that they are 80% confluent.
Make a transfection mix using OptiMEM, Lipofectamine RNAiMAX, and siRNA stock solutions.
Dilute the Lipofectamine RNAiMAX (2.25 μL per well) in OptiMEM (37.5 μL per well).
Dilute the siRNA (0.75 pM per well) in OptiMEM (37.5 μL per well).
Add diluted siRNA to diluted Lipofectamine RNAiMAX reagent in a 1:1 ratio.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature (20°C–26°C) for 5 minutes.
Add 75 μL of transfection mix into each well of both the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate and the standard 48-well tissue culture plate.
Place both plates at the back of the tissue culture incubator to limit environmental changes.
Allow the plates to rest overnight in the cell culture incubator.
Retrieve the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate and standard 48-well tissue culture plate from the incubator on day 2.
Remove PGM-2 and add 200 μL of fresh Adipocyte Differentiation Medium to each well in the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate.
Repeat the addition of differentiation medium for the standard 48-well tissue culture plate.
Return both plates to the back of the incubator for 48 hours.
View cells under the microscope after 48 hours to assess cell health and morphology.
Cells are now ready for oxygen consumption analysis.
Invert the Seahorse XF24 sensor cartridge such that it is upside down.
Fill each well of the utility plate with 1 mL of XF Calibrant, carefully lower the Seahorse XF24 sensor cartridge back onto the utility plate and ensure that each sensor is properly submerged.
Place the Seahorse XF24 sensor cartridge and utility plate overnight in a humidified, non-CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Aliquot 40 mL of Seahorse XF DMEM Medium into a 50 mL conical tube to be used for washing steps.
Incubate the Seahorse XF DMEM Medium at 37°C until ready for use.
Incubate the Seahorse XF 1.0 M Glucose Solution at 37°C until ready for use.
Incubate the Seahorse XF 100 mM Pyruvate Solution at 37°C until ready for use.
Incubate the Seahorse XF 200 mM Glutamine Solution (aliquot) at 37°C until ready for use.
Prepare the Respiration Assay Medium by adding appropriate volumes of XF supplements as indicated in the tables.
Incubate the Respiration Assay Medium at 37°C for no more than 4 hours.
Retrieve the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate from the incubator.
Assess cell health under a microscope and document observations.
Carefully remove all but 50 μL of the Assay Differentiation Medium.
Add 200 μL of fresh Respiration Assay Medium to each well.
Repeat the previous two steps one more time for consistency.
Use a multichannel pipette to add 500 μL of Respiration Assay Medium to each well.
View the cells under the microscope.
Check for any cell damage.
Incubate the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate at 37°C in a non-CO2 incubator for 60 min prior to assay commencement.
Retrieve the Agilent Seahorse XF Cell Mito Stress Test Kit from -20°C storage.
Allow the compounds to warm to room temperature for approximately 15 min.
Resuspend Oligomycin with Respiration Assay Medium using volumes described in table(s).
Gently pipette the medium up and down roughly 10 times to solubilize Oligomycin.
Resuspend FCCP with Respiration Assay Medium using volumes described in table(s).
Gently pipette the medium up and down roughly 10 times to solubilize FCCP.
Resuspend Antimycin A with Respiration Assay Medium using volumes described in table(s).
Gently pipette the medium up and down roughly 10 times to solubilize Antimycin A.
Use Oligomycin stock solution to make working solutions for loading into injection ports of sensor cartridge.
Use FCCP stock solution to make working solutions for loading into injection ports of sensor cartridge.
Use Antimycin A stock solution to make working solutions for loading into injection ports of sensor cartridge.
Load the sensor cartridge ports with working solutions using multichannel pipettes and reagent reservoirs.
Ensure external packaging is removed from the sensor cartridge before loading it into the instrument tray.
Verify a secure fit between the utility plate, cell culture plate, and instrument tray.
Conduct a final orientation check to ensure all pieces are correctly aligned.
Place the loaded sensor cartridge onto the utility plate and then on the instrument tray.
Start the respiration assay 40 minutes after placing the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate in a non-CO2 incubator.
Calibrate the system for 20 minutes before starting the assay.
Replace the utility plate with the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate when prompted by the instrument.
Click “Start” to initiate the respiration assay, which will take approximately 2 hours.
Once all measurements are completed and an “Unload Sensor Cartridge” message appears, click “Eject.”
Separate the sensor cartridge from the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate after ejection.
Check the injection ports of the sensor cartridge for any remaining medium to identify failed injections.
Wash each well twice in the Seahorse XF24 cell culture microplate with 500 μL PBS.
Lyse the cell with 50 μL Protein Extraction Buffer containing Complete Protease Inhibitor Cocktail EDTA-free.
Gently pipette up and down 10 times to homogenize.
Centrifuge the homogenate at 4°C at 15,000 × g for 20 min.
Analyze the protein concentration using a protein quantification assay using bicinchoninic acid.
